sources: Ministry of Economic Affairs and Employment
EU Programmes (Horizon Europe, Digital Europe, Innovation Fund, LIFE, CEF)

programs.name: Development Grant (Kehittämisavustus)
programs.description: Support for business development projects to develop products, services, processes, or business models.

eligibility.annual_turnover: Max EUR 50 million OR balance sheet max EUR 43 million

funding_details.percentage: Up to 50% of development costs (up to 60% for lump-sum projects; investments typically 10-40% depending on region and company size)
funding_details.max_amount: Subject to state-aid and call-specific limits (grants can range from around EUR 10,000 up to several million euros per project)
funding_details.min_project_cost: Minimum grant typically around EUR 10,000 (project must be larger than this)

programs.application_process: Apply through ELY Centre online service

programs.name: Start-up Grant (Starttiraha)
programs.description: Basic income for new entrepreneurs starting full-time business.

requirements: Cannot receive overlapping unemployment benefit for the same period

funding_details.amount: Approximately EUR 740 per month (37.21 €/day in 2025, paid for up to 5 days per week; amount is indexed and may change annually)

programs.application_process: Apply before starting business through ELY Centre

programs.name: Business Loan Guarantee
programs.description: State-backed guarantee from Finnvera for business loans to reduce collateral requirements.

funding_details.max_guarantee: Varies by guarantee product (e.g. SME Guarantee up to around EUR 300,000 in total exposure; larger guarantees case-by-case)
funding_details.fee: Risk-based guarantee fee (and possible service fee) charged to the company

programs.name: Entrepreneur Loan (Yrittäjälaina)
programs.description: Personal loan for a company’s shareholder or business successor to finance ownership arrangements, such as acquiring shares or investing in the company’s share capital.

eligibility.company_type: Shareholder or successor in a limited liability company (SME)
eligibility.company_age: Start-up or established company; target company must have prerequisites for profitable business
requirements: Borrower holds at least 5% of the share capital and votes after the investment or share transaction financed with the loan
Borrower works in the company or serves as a Board member
Borrower’s personal finances are in good order
Target company has prerequisites for profitable business
Loan is used for ownership arrangements (not for working capital, equity boosting of a company in difficulty, or large corporate incentive programmes)

funding_details.amount: Minimum EUR 20,000; final loan amount decided case-by-case according to financing need and borrower’s repayment ability
funding_details.interest_rate: Six-month Euribor + fixed margin of 3.75% p.a. (plus management fee; pricing may change over time)
funding_details.repayment: Loan period typically 5–6 years, maximum 12 years (grace period possible case-by-case)

programs.name: Finnvera Working Capital Loan
programs.description: Finnvera Loan used to finance working capital needs as part of an overall financing package for SMEs.

eligibility.company_type: SME (and, on special grounds, larger companies)
eligibility.company_size: Typically fewer than 250 employees; turnover max EUR 50 million or balance-sheet total max EUR 43 million
requirements: Start-up or established company with prerequisites for profitable business
Working capital and/or investment financing need in Finland
Overall financing package planned together with a bank or other financiers

funding_details.amount: Minimum EUR 50,000; upper limit decided case-by-case as part of the overall financing package
funding_details.duration: Generally 3–15 years depending on the nature and size of the project
funding_details.collateral: Security negotiated case-by-case (often bank and/or other collateral required)

programs.name: Finnvera Investment Loan
programs.description: Finnvera Loan used as long-term financing for domestic investment projects such as construction, machinery and equipment, and energy and environmental investments.

eligibility.company_type: SME (and, on special grounds, companies larger than an SME)
eligibility.company_size: Typically fewer than 250 employees; annual turnover max EUR 50 million or balance sheet total max EUR 43 million
requirements: Start-up or established company with prerequisites for profitable business
Investment project in Finland (e.g. construction, machinery and equipment, energy or environmental projects)
Overall financing package planned together with a bank or other financiers
Company operates in a sector Finnvera can finance (e.g. excludes farming, forestry and property development)

funding_details.amount: Minimum EUR 50,000; final loan amount decided case-by-case according to project size and repayment ability
funding_details.duration: Generally 3–15 years depending on the character and size of the investment
funding_details.finnvera_share: Loan is typically part of a financing package with a bank; Finnvera’s share of the total financing is agreed case-by-case

programs.name: Finnvera Export Credit Guarantee
programs.description: Protection against commercial and political risks in exports.

eligibility.company_type: Exporting companies and banks of all sizes
requirements: Export activities involving Finnish interest (Finnish exporter or significant Finnish content/value-add)
Credit or payment risk related to a foreign buyer, buyer’s bank or buyer’s country
Credit period can be short, medium or long term depending on guarantee type (often used for credit periods over 2 years in larger transactions)

funding_details.coverage: Typically up to 90–95% for commercial risks and up to 100% for political risks, depending on guarantee type and transaction
funding_details.fee: Risk-based premium and handling fees determined case-by-case

programs.name: Research and Development Funding for SMEs and Midcaps
programs.description: Funding for R&D projects to develop new products, services, production methods or business models for international markets.

eligibility.company_size: SME: max 250 employees, turnover max EUR 50M or balance sheet max EUR 43M. Midcap: group-level turnover max EUR 300M.
requirements: Developing innovative products, services, production methods or business models
Solution creates competitive advantage in international markets
Creating new expertise for competitive advantage
Sufficient overall financing for the project
Project not yet started at the time of application

funding_details.percentage: Grant: SME research projects 50% of eligible costs (60% if the project content is entirely industrial research); Midcap research projects 40% (50% if entirely industrial research). Loan for development and piloting typically up to 50% of total project costs and up to 70% in justified cases.
funding_details.typical_amount: Projects often range from hundreds of thousands to several million euros depending on scope.
funding_details.min_project_cost: Project budgets are usually at least around EUR 100,000.

programs.name: Research and Development Funding for Large Companies
programs.description: Grants and loans for large companies to conduct research, development and piloting projects that create new expertise, solutions and international competitive advantage.

eligibility.company_size: Large company: bigger than an SME or midcap (SME: <250 employees and turnover ≤ EUR 50M or balance sheet ≤ EUR 43M; midcap: group-level turnover ≤ EUR 300M). Companies above this are considered large.
requirements: Genuine aim for significant international growth
Developing new innovative products or services, production methods or business models that will gain a competitive advantage in international markets
Creating new expertise and networks that provide a significant competitive edge
Sufficient self-financing and overall financial soundness
For grant-funded research projects, at least 40% of project costs must be used to purchase services from SMEs and/or research organisations
For loan-funded development and piloting projects, at least 15% of project costs must be used to purchase services from SMEs or research organisations
Project has not started before the funding decision

funding_details.percentage: Grant for research projects: 40% of eligible project costs (50% if the project content is entirely industrial research). Loan for development and piloting can cover up to 50% of total project costs; up to 30% of the loan may be paid as an advance.
funding_details.typical_amount: Project sizes vary from hundreds of thousands to several million euros; there is no fixed public upper limit and the amount depends on project scope and impact.
funding_details.interest: Loan interest rate is three percentage points lower than the official base rate in force, but at least 1% per year; loans are generally granted without collateral and the loan period is typically 7–10 years with 3–5 instalment-free years.

programs.name: Research and Development Funding for Creative Industries
programs.description: Earmarked R&D funding for companies whose projects renew the creative industries and support bold international growth.

eligibility.company_type: Companies of any size engaged in economic activity with a strong creative industries link (Business Finland does not fund one-person companies)
requirements: Project based on creative skills or solutions for the creative industries
R&D project aiming at bold renewal and international business growth
Cannot finance core content production (e.g. single game, TV series, film, music album, artwork or clothing collection, or routine work generating normal revenue)
Sufficient capabilities and team to steer international growth
Project not yet started at the time of application

funding_details.type: Grant (and in some cases loan, according to Business Finland’s general R&D funding rules)
funding_details.percentage: For small and medium-sized enterprises, development of products, services and business models can be supported with a 35% R&D grant instead of the normal 50% loan; depending on the level of research and company size, support may be higher or lower, or in loan form.
funding_details.typical_amount: Business Finland has earmarked EUR 9 million per year of its funding authorization specifically for R&D in the creative industries from 2025 onwards; individual project funding typically ranges from tens of thousands up to a few million euros depending on scope.

programs.deadline: Call-based; specific funding calls for creative industries R&D are opened with announced application periods (not a fully continuous scheme).

programs.name: Innovative Public Procurement
programs.description: Funding for public procurement units to carry out innovative procurements that renew public services and operations.

eligibility.company_type: Public procurement units (e.g. municipalities, joint municipal authorities, government agencies and other contracting entities covered by the Public Procurement Act)
requirements: Public procurement unit as applicant aiming at long-term development and renewal of its services and operations

Procurement implemented as an innovative procurement (e.g. purchase of a new solution, pre-commercial procurement or catalyst procurement) with cooperation between the procurer, companies and end users
Project size significant enough to boost the sector and, in practice, a large share of the budget (at least around 80%) consisting of research and development activities

funding_details.percentage: Business Finland typically funds around 50% of the project’s eligible costs.
funding_details.typical_amount: Funding is granted case-by-case; supported projects have ranged from hundreds of thousands to several million euros depending on the scope and size of the procurement.

programs.name: Tempo Funding
programs.description: Business development funding for developing growth strategy and internationalization readiness.

requirements: Developing growth strategy, market entry, or business model

funding_details.percentage: Business Finland grant up to 75% of eligible project costs (company self-financing at least 25%)
funding_details.max_amount: EUR 60,000 per project (max project budget typically around EUR 80,000)
funding_details.min_project_cost: Total project budget typically at least around EUR 30,000

programs.deadline: Call currently closed to new applications (Tempo funding call closed on 3 October 2025)

programs.name: Innovation Voucher (Innovaatioseteli)
programs.description: De minimis aid for SMEs to purchase external expert services to develop a completely new product or service idea with international growth potential.

eligibility.company_type: SME in corporate form (not sole trader, large enterprise, public or non-profit organisation, foundation, association, or Åland-based company)
requirements: Company is in the prepayment register
Credit rating (Rating Alfa, Suomen Asiakastieto) at least A
Full-time entrepreneur in the company for at least 3 months OR at least one full-time employee employed for at least 3 months before applying
New product or service idea with international growth potential (not just further development of an existing product/service)
Need for external expert services to progress the idea
De minimis aid limits not exceeded and no conflicting ongoing Business Finland funding (with specified exceptions in current criteria)

funding_details.amount: Typically EUR 6,000 (covers 100% of the purchased expert services excluding VAT; company can receive the voucher only once)
funding_details.use_of_funds: Purchase external expert services for innovation activities, such as feasibility and marketability studies, demos and prototypes, testing and experiments, IPR and novelty studies, or using research results.
funding_details.notes: Funding criteria and call status have changed over time; always check Business Finland for the latest information.

programs.deadline: Call-based; application windows opened periodically (check Business Finland website for current status).

programs.name: Young Innovative Companies (YIC)
programs.description: Multi-year funding package for young startups with high growth potential.

eligibility.company_age: Under 5 years old at first decision, max 8 years at end
eligibility.company_size: Small company: under 50 employees, max EUR 10M turnover/balance sheet
requirements: Min 10% of total costs in R&D in one of the past three financial years
Not continued another company's business (not formed through merger, demerger or acquisition of existing operations)
No profit distribution during the funding period
Opportunity and willingness to obtain external growth funding (e.g. private capital investments)

funding_details.type: Grant (three phases; for companies selected before 1 January 2024 the third phase may instead be a loan)
funding_details.phase1: EUR 250,000 grant (phase 1; typically covers up to 75% of eligible costs)
funding_details.phase2: EUR 250,000 grant (phase 2; typically covers up to 75% of eligible costs)
funding_details.total: Up to EUR 1,000,000 in grants over three phases for companies selected from 2024 onwards (EUR 250,000 + 250,000 + 500,000; earlier funding decisions may have a loan in the third phase instead of a grant)

programs.deadline: Call currently closed to new applications (Young Innovative Companies funding call closed on 10 October 2025; existing NIY projects continue)

programs.name: Production Incentive for the Audiovisual Industry
programs.description: Up to 25% cash rebate for audiovisual productions with eligible production costs incurred in Finland.

eligibility.company_type: Finnish or foreign production companies and other audiovisual companies selected for the production
requirements: Professional audiovisual production (feature film, documentary film, scripted series-type fiction or animation)
Minimum expenditure in Finland at least EUR 500,000
Minimum total production budget: feature film EUR 2,500,000; documentary film EUR 650,000; serial fiction and animation at least EUR 11,500 per finished minute
If the beneficiary is a foreign company, a Finnish production coordinator with a Finnish business ID is required

funding_details.percentage: Up to 25% of eligible production costs incurred in Finland (pre-production, production and post-production); eligible Finnish costs may be a maximum of 80% of the total production budget
funding_details.typical_amount: At least around EUR 125,000 given the minimum EUR 500,000 spend in Finland; actual rebates can reach several million euros for large productions

programs.deadline: Continuous, rolling first-come-first-served while the annual budget remains available

programs.name: Funding for Leading Companies and Ecosystems
programs.description: Large-scale funding for ecosystem-driving innovation projects.

requirements: Globally operating large company as driver

programs.name: Funding for Innovation and Growth Research
programs.description: Funding for research organizations studying impact of global challenges on Finnish business and society.

programs.name: Deep Tech Accelerator (DTA)
programs.description: Funding for deep tech startups commercializing research results.

funding_details.percentage: Business Finland covers up to 75% of eligible costs; phases 1-2 are grants and phase 3 is a loan
funding_details.amount: Up to EUR 1,200,000 (three phases of up to EUR 400,000 each)
funding_details.duration: Each phase typically 12-18 months (overall program up to around 4 years)

programs.name: Energy Aid
programs.description: Support for renewable energy, energy efficiency, and energy system projects.

funding_details.percentage: 15-40% depending on project type and size

programs.name: Innovation Aid for Shipbuilding
programs.description: State aid for innovative ship and offshore solutions.

requirements: Innovation beyond state of the art

funding_details.percentage: Up to 25% of innovation costs (up to 10% of contract value)

programs.name: European Defense Fund National Co-Funding
programs.description: National co-funding for projects receiving EDF funding from EU.

requirements: EDF project approved by EU Commission
Apply within 90 days of EDF Grant Agreement

funding_details.percentage: Covers national co-financing requirement (typically 20% for SME, 40% for large)

programs.deadline: Within 90 days of EDF Grant Agreement

programs.name: Preparatory Funding for Horizon Europe, EDF and Innovation Fund
programs.description: Funding for preparing EU project applications.

requirements: Preparing Horizon Europe, EDF, or Innovation Fund application

programs.name: Investment Aid for Large Clean Transition Investments
programs.description: Aid for large investments (EUR 30M+) in decarbonization and energy efficiency.

funding_details.percentage: Typically 15-50% of eligible costs depending on project type, company size and location (subject to EU state-aid rules)
funding_details.typical_amount: Grant support often in the range of EUR 10,000,000 - 150,000,000 for eligible projects

programs.name: Tax Credit for Large Clean Transition Investments
programs.description: Tax credit for investments (EUR 50M+) in renewable energy, decarbonization, and climate-neutral production.

funding_details.percentage: 20% of eligible costs for qualifying investments (single basic rate under the current scheme)
funding_details.calculation: Tax credit of 20% of eligible costs, claimed against corporate income tax in annual instalments (maximum 10% of the credit per year, typically between 2028 and 2047)
funding_details.typical_amount: Varies by project; for eligible investments of at least EUR 50,000,000 the tax credit can reach tens of millions of euros

programs.name: Circular Economy Investment Grant
programs.description: Grant for circular economy investments exceeding environmental standards or increasing recycling.

requirements: Improves environmental protection beyond EU standards
OR increases waste recycling beyond state of technical development

funding_details.percentage: Up to 45% for SME, 35% for midcap, 25% for large company

programs.name: Funding for Business Development in Disruptive Circumstances
programs.description: Temporary funding instrument used during crises (e.g. COVID-19) to support business development and adaptation; not currently open.

requirements: Affected by disruptive circumstances (crisis, pandemic, etc.)

funding_details.percentage: Varies by situation and company size

programs.deadline: Program was temporary and is no longer open (used during specific disruptive periods such as COVID-19)
